name: Step-Down Synchronous Voltage Regulator IC (5V/3A, SOT-23-6)

properties.specifications: High-efficiency 1.5MHz synchronous step-down converter, input 4.5V-18V, output 5V/3A, thermal shutdown threshold 140°C.

name: Quality Alert & Voluntary Recall: Thermal Breakdown in Voltage Regulator ICs

properties.defectDescription: Thermal breakdown under continuous operation (>28°C ambient) causing gate-oxide micro-fractures, output voltage ripple fluctuation exceeding 1.2V, and sudden power cutoffs.
properties.symptomsReported: Erratic flickering light, intermittent wireless charging disconnections, and unexpected star projector reboot cycles.
properties.recommendedAction: Immediate RMA exchange and board-level replacement of batch BATCH-VREG-2026 regulators.
